panels.title: Charge d'entraînement par jour
panels.description: Somme de la charge Garmin des activités du jour, toutes disciplines confondues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT local_date::timestamp AS time, sport, sum(coalesce(training_load, trimp, 0)) AS value FROM activity WHERE $__timeFilter(local_date) GROUP BY local_date, sport ORDER BY local_date

panels.title: HRV nocturne et baseline
panels.description: La baseline est celle calculée par Garmin. Une HRV qui décroche sous la borne basse plusieurs nuits de suite est le signal de fatigue à surveiller.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamp AS time, avg_hrv_ms AS "HRV", baseline_balanced_low AS "baseline basse", baseline_balanced_high AS "baseline haute" FROM hrv_night WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

SELECT s.sleep_date::timestamp AS time, s.score AS "score sommeil", round(s.duration_s / 3600.0, 2) AS "durée sommeil", w.resting_hr AS "FC repos" FROM sleep_session s LEFT JOIN daily_wellness w ON w.athlete_id = s.athlete_id AND w.day = s.sleep_date WHERE $__timeFilter(s.sleep_date) ORDER BY s.sleep_date

panels.title: Dernières sorties et récupération du matin
panels.description: Chaque activité en regard de l'état de récupération mesuré au réveil du même jour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_time_local AS "date", sport, name AS "sortie", round(distance_m / 1000.0, 1) AS "km", round(elevation_gain_m) AS "D+", round(elapsed_s / 60.0) AS "min", avg_hr AS "FC moy", training_load AS "charge", hrv_ms AS "HRV", sleep_score AS "sommeil" FROM marts.v_activity_with_recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time_local) ORDER BY start_time_local DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT time, metric AS metric, value FROM wellness_reading WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND metric IN ('body_battery', 'stress') ORDER BY time
